message: Initial plan

Add GitHub Actions workflow for upstream sync

Create sync-upstream.yml workflow that:
- Runs daily at 6:00 AM UTC or on manual trigger
- Fetches tags from upstream juanfont/headscale
- Detects latest stable release (vX.Y.Z pattern)
- Creates branch and attempts merge
- Creates PR if merge succeeds
- Logs warning if conflicts occur
